up: Retrieve the first 1000 activity rows that are IC50 measurements with exact standard relation ('=') and non-null pChEMBL values, for the human single-protein target CHEMBL1861 (4-hydroxyphenylpyruvate dioxygenase). The target must be a single protein (target_type = 'SINGLE PROTEIN') and from Homo sapiens (organism = 'Homo sapiens', tax_id = 9606). Return the following columns: assay ChEMBL ID (assays.chembl_id), target type (target_dictionary.target_type), tax ID (target_dictionary.tax_id), canonical SMILES (compound_structures.canonical_smiles), molecule ChEMBL ID (molecule_dictionary.chembl_id), standard type (activities.standard_type), and pChEMBL value (activities.pchembl_value). Order the results by molecule ChEMBL ID ascending, then by assay ChEMBL ID ascending. Limit the output to 1000 rows. Do not add any extra filters beyond those specified.
sql:
SELECT
  assays.chembl_id AS assay_chembl_id,
  target_dictionary.target_type,
  target_dictionary.tax_id,
  compound_structures.canonical_smiles,
  molecule_dictionary.chembl_id AS molecule_chembl_id,
  activities.standard_type,
  activities.pchembl_value
FROM activities
JOIN assays ON activities.assay_id = assays.assay_id
JOIN target_dictionary ON assays.tid = target_dictionary.tid
JOIN molecule_dictionary ON activities.molregno = molecule_dictionary.molregno
JOIN compound_structures ON molecule_dictionary.molregno = compound_structures.molregno
WHERE
  target_dictionary.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1861'
  AND target_dictionary.target_type = 'SINGLE PROTEIN'
  AND target_dictionary.organism = 'Homo sapiens'
  AND target_dictionary.tax_id = 9606
  AND activities.standard_type = 'IC50'
  AND activities.standard_relation = '='
  AND activities.pchembl_value IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY molecule_chembl_id, assay_chembl_id
LIMIT 1000;
